verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents its own TOTP code generation for saved logins and passkey support, and a user reports relying on the browser extension for all 2FA. However, no evidence explicitly says the extension autofills TOTP codes or passkeys into login forms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser-extension autofill for TOTP codes, explicit documentation of passkey autofill/authentication through the extension, independent hands-on corroboration of autofill behavior.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Passkeys allow you to authenticate yourself for online accounts without using passwords or passphrases.
Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA. I love the browser extension, so easy and sleek.
